sub_site: pancreatic cancer tissue and paired adjacent tissue

evidence.quote: All human samples (including 47 cases of pancreatic cancer and adjacent tissues), as well as the clinical data, were obtained from our hospital.
V3-V4 variable region amplification and sequencing were performed using the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing platform

notes: 47 paired tumour + adjacent tissues (94 samples). Country not stated explicitly ('our hospital'; discussion refers to future Chinese centres). Only LEfSe genera named; profiles in figures. No negative controls mentioned. TCMbio (TCGA) used only for survival analysis.
